about: FSVR's VOP3 programs ported from microcode to C++, one row per chip program the FS1R loads. A row is done when tools/vop3_native_check <key> reports identical: bit for bit against the interpreter, on every type that runs it. docs/vop3_native/README.md is the brief.

programs.start_from: git show a9cb37d^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_filter.h (the measured 4-pole ladder and 2-pole state-variable structure), docs/filter.md
programs.note: Rewritten as plain DSP, no chip: src/filters/voice_filter.h is one voice's ladder (the program's 16 voices share nothing), src/filters/filter.h runs one per channel, 32 in two banks of 16 host slots. vop3_native_check flt compares it slot by slot against the chip running the firmware's program: identical, 6 types, 57600 samples x 16 slots.

programs.start_from: git show 29f589c^:src/fs1r/chips/vop3_effects.h: the reverb block's model of No Effect, Hall1, Hall2, Room1, Room2, Room3, Stage1, Stage2, Plate, White Room, Tunnel, Basement, Canyon
programs.note: Lifted to plain DSP by tools/fx_lift: src/effects/base.cpp (the reverb is part of the base program), a function of the effect State, no chip. vop3_native_check against the chip interpreter: identical, every sample and the delay memory, all 87 effect types.
